headline: Commission seeks list of county-funded youth programs

meeting.summary: The commission approved its minutes and voted to request a list of county-funded youth programs, aiming to build awareness of available resources.
meeting.recap: Members voted seven to zero to approve the August 24, 2026 meeting minutes.[[0:03:16]] A commissioner said a press release about reporting was sent to the county communications team.[[0:06:50]] The commission's community survey pointed to behavioral health supports for youth and families as a concern.[[0:08:25]] Members described Youthline, a mental health line run by youth for youth, with adult oversight.[[0:13:43]] A commissioner said the gap may be a lack of awareness of services, not a lack of resources.[[0:37:56]] Members agreed to focus on building awareness of available resources.[[0:40:14]] A youth advisory group, not run by the commission, has a sign-up flyer with a QR code.[[0:51:20]] The group hopes to hold its first meeting in mid-October.[[0:51:55]] Members discussed reporting survey results once a year or after reaching a set number of responses.[[0:57:33]] The meeting adjourned at 3:34 p.m.[[1:03:27]]
meeting.next: The budget request will stay on the agenda to check its status at the next meeting. The press release item will stay on the agenda for a status update at the next meeting. The chair hopes the program list arrives before the next meeting so it can go out with the meeting packet. The secretary will email commissioners the youth advisory group's first meeting agenda and virtual link to share when it is available. The chair proposed an agenda item at the next meeting on annual survey reporting and a response goal.

moments.q: A commissioner asks what the commission should focus on
"I don't necessarily think it is a lack of resources. I think it's a lack of awareness"
